title: Oakland's Creole Cafe and playing with Jelly Roll Morton at Jump Steady
summary: After San Francisco, the band played the Creole Cafe in Oakland and a Los Angeles dance run by Jelly Roll Morton in Watts.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: To Akamacha, and then after we left the Deluxe, I mean after we left the Percola, we played the Creole, then we, uh, Jolly wanted us- The Creole where? Cafe here. On Severn and Woods, where Slim Jenkins is at.
This is, what town is this now? Oakland, California. Oh, in Oakland.

And we come back to Los Angeles to play one night dance for Jolly Roll out to, uh, jump steady. Really? Yeah, we come and we played the set and- What was jump steady? Big old dance hall. Where? Way out in Watts.
